description: This file contains utility functions for handling repository paths, module specifiers, inventory diffing, and inventory collection, primarily focused on TypeScript files. It appears to be part of a build or analysis tool for managing code inventories.

methods.name: normalizeRepoPath
methods.description: Converts an absolute file path into a repository-relative path using forward slashes.

methods.name: resolveRepoSpecifier
methods.description: Resolves a module specifier relative to the repository root, handling relative and absolute specifiers.

methods.name: visitModuleSpecifiers
methods.description: Traverses a TypeScript source file's AST to identify import, export, and dynamic import specifiers.

methods.name: diffInventoryEntries
methods.description: Compares two inventories and identifies missing and unexpected entries.

methods.name: writeLine
methods.description: Writes a line of text to a writable stream.

methods.name: collectTypeScriptInventory
methods.description: Reads multiple files, parses them as TypeScript source files, and collects inventory entries.

methods.name: runBaselineInventoryCheck
methods.description: Performs a baseline check comparing the actual inventory against an expected inventory, outputting results.
